_about: getEndUser answers that the app's gate (backend/services/identity_lookup._cii_parse) and the Mac's persona self-check (deploy/lab5/lab5_cii.parse_end_user) must read the same way. expect: found (details), not_found (CII's 'no such user'), unavailable (anything else). An unavailable case may carry trust, failing and reasons: what a partial answer did say, which the gate keeps and still blocks on (reasons: its block; none: nothing against the user), while the self-check reads every unavailable answer as a failed query. Run by tests/test_identity_gate.py and tests/test_identity_personas.py.

wording._about: Messages of a code-less error, each tried on getEndUser (getEndUser null) and on its endUserDetails (getEndUser an object, endUserDetails null). not_found: CII's 'no such user'. unavailable: words about something else (a permission, a scope, a pool, a session), never that answer, including a word that ends a sentence right after 'no user', a scope name or list that starts with 'user' (user:read.all too), a quoted, backticked or parenthesized word after 'user' or 'no user', a login keyword with no login after it, and a 'no user' that ends a sentence about something else. A login is an address: an '@' with a word character after it and no space in it, bare, quoted, in backticks or in parentheses.
